title: 新旧版XGBRanker：整数股回测与模型评估

source.label: 使用target1标签的排序质量
source.classification: local supplied data and historical modeled scenarios
filters: 两版共同40只股票、210周；正文资金100000、单边10bps；每个窗口独立重跑

metricDefinitions.label: 评估口径
metricDefinitions.definition: Rank IC=每周预测与target1的Spearman相关再取均值；ICIR=周Rank IC均值/样本标准差，不年化；NDCG@5使用每周真实收益0至4档相关性；与实际交易盈亏分别处理

caveats: 开收盘代理价格尚未独立核验复权与可成交性；无外汇转换
target1仅用于预测评估，组合盈亏依据价格和整数股

methods.code: Reproduce with prepare_comparison.py, replay_old50.py, integer_backtest.py, evaluate_comparison.py, build_report.py. Filter recorded SQL results to the named window and strategy; NAV=end_capital/capital. Initial NAV=1 uses first signal minus seven days as an initial marker, not a trade-date claim.
